name: io.github.raldblox/flying-money
title: Flying Money
description: Let an AI agent pay APIs in USDC from a capped, expiring budget its owner approves. Ordinary x402 sites work through a bridge.

environmentVariables.name: FM_OWNER
environmentVariables.description: The owner's wallet address (the person who approves budgets).

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_CHAINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated networks. Defaults to test networks; name a mainnet only for real money.

environmentVariables.name: FM_BRIDGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: An x402 bridge, to pay ordinary x402 sites.
